name: io.github.OpenConverters/kelvin
title: Kelvin — power electronics components
description: Deterministic, read-only parts catalogue for power electronics (MOSFETs, diodes, capacitors, resistors, magnetics, controllers, IGBTs, BJTs, varistors/TVS, analog ICs, timing, connectors): parametric search, part lookup, requirement-based selection, scored cross-reference and spec distributions. No LLM inside.
